notes: The state's 2026 MD/MS notice (both copies) prints no tuition: only the application fee (Rs. 2,000; NRI Rs. 10,000) and the refundable registration/security deposit — Govt colleges UR 25,000/-, SC/ST/OBC 12,500/-; private college or private+govt choice 2,00,000/-. The Drive copy's extra pages are the NBEMS result notice and the CG Gazette rules.

Three government colleges' own 2026 documents (JNM, CIMS, Korba) all print Tuition Fee Rs. 20,000/-; the other four government colleges have published nothing for 2026, so no state-wide figure is recorded.
Owner's rule applied: the fee committee / Medical Education Dept private MD/MS fee orders (2024, 23-09-2025) were not used.
